attBesluta.text: Fonctionne très bien plus 1 an que je les acheté super efficace je les installer dans ma véranda la ou je fume très bonnes aspiration génial
Bought 2 of these for my crawl space. Works great. Easy to connect to power outlet and both fans could be connected to one display/controller.
Boven in de nok van de garage geplaats. Scheelt aanzienlijk in temperatuur en bij het testen van een motor, zuigt hij de "rook" mooi af

My garage needed better cooling because there is servers running there. This 305mm fan model has been good size for me. Also had to do 315mm inlet for cold fresh air to ventilation to work properly. It was interesting project. So far fan has been working as it should. Programming was easy and you can have celsius temperatures on controller also. Came with EU shuko plug, so easy to power on.
Ventilátor funguje super, jen displey je černobílý a je velmi špatně vidět.
